newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 14 bln dong T-notes, rate 7.89 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 14 bln dong T-notes, rate 7.89 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 14 billion dong ($1.265 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 7.89 percent at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on October 23, the central bank issued 27 billion dong worth of one-year notes at the same rate.
The bank had originally said it would auction 50 billion dong worth of notes on Wednesday.
At the last auction it also allocated less than it had originally planned, which bankers said reflected the central bank's efforts to keep a cap on interest rates.
The issue date of the notes is November 15, 1996 and maturity will be on November 15, 1997.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong and all to domestic institutions, were as follows:
Vietnam General Insurance Corp (Bao Viet) 6.5 billion
Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam 2.0 billion
Petrolimex Joint Stock Insurance company 1.5 billion
